propositions: Multiple S3 bundles for one ref cause ref ambiguity (git ls-remote returns multiple SHAs) and store unclonability (hard-fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed'), with push rejected by git-remote-s3 at bundles>1 before any write, stalling indefinitely when retry-fetch cannot resolve the ambiguous ref.

Upstream git-remote-s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocking input() prompts that crash on EOF) and side-branches non-chosen heads to orphan refs, losing their unique events and making it unsuitable for autonomous repair in an append-only event log.

heal_multi_bundle must losslessly merge N divergent bundle heads via iterated 2-parent merges (no octopus, no merge=union driver) following sync's existing _union_merge semantics, guaranteeing every unique commit from every head is reachable in the final merged tip.

heal_multi_bundle must order operations as: acquire helper per-ref lock -> re-enumerate (TOCTOU guard) -> fetch all heads locally -> merge under write_lock -> write merged bundle as new object (durability barrier) -> delete originals (never the merged tip) -> release lock, ensuring >=1 bundle carrying full merged history persists at every crash point.
On real content conflict in a non-derived, non-bridge_state file, heal_multi_bundle must abort, delete no remote bundles, release locks, and surface fsck-recover hint without discarding any parent.

push_tickets_branch must detect multi-bundle signatures (_is_multi_bundle matching 'multiple bundles exists on server' and 'multiple updates for ref') and invoke heal_multi_bundle exactly once via healed_once guard before normal non-FF recovery, preventing heal-retry thrash.
